name: IDNA Convert
description: Provides IDNA Convert Service and demo-page.
project_description: IDNA Convert exposes the algo26-matthias/idna-convert PHP library as a Drupal service (registered as `idna` and `idna.service`) for converting domain names, URLs and email hosts between Unicode and Punycode (IDNA / "xn--…"). Call \Drupal::service('idna')->encode($input) for Unicode → Punycode and ->decode($input) for the reverse. A permission-gated demo page at /idna offers two AJAX forms (Encode / Decode). The 2.x branch targets Drupal ^11 || ^12 and requires the idna-convert library ^4.2. No settings form, config schema, hooks, drush commands, or plugin types.
